import re

DEFAULT_COLS = ['System Pool', 'Pool Size (M)', 'Reserved Size (M)', 'Max Active', 'DB Fault', 'DB Pages', 'Non-DB Fault', 'Non-DB Pages', 'Act-Wait', 'Wait-Inel', 'Act-Inel']
KV = re.compile(r'(%?\s*[A-Za-z][A-Za-z %]*?)[\s.]*:\s*([\d.:]+(?:\s[KMGT]\b)?)?')
SEC = re.compile(r'(?:^|\s{2,})(?P<name>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z ]*?):\s*$')
TITLE = re.compile(r'^\s*Work with System Status\s+(?P<sys>\S+)\s*$')
DATE = re.compile(r'^\s*(?P<date>\d+/\d+/\d+)\s+(?P<time>\d+:\d+:\d+)(?:\s+(?P<tz>\S+))?\s*$')
HEAD = re.compile(r'^\s*System\s+Pool\b')
ROW = re.compile(r'^\s*\d+(?:\s+\S+)+\s*$')
TOK = re.compile(r'\S+(?: \S+)*')

def spans(line):
    return [(m.start(), m.end(), m.group()) for m in TOK.finditer(line)]

def merge(up, low):
    cols = []
    for ls, le, lt in low:
        best = None
        bo = 0
        for us, ue, ut in up:
            o = min(le, ue) - max(ls, us)
            if o > bo:
                bo = o
                best = ut
        if best is None:
            cols.append(lt)
            continue
        u = best.strip('-')
        if best.endswith('-') and not best.startswith('-'):
            cols.append(best + lt)
        elif u:
            cols.append(u + ' ' + lt)
        else:
            cols.append(lt)
    return cols

def parse(lines):
    info = {}
    info_lines = []
    rows = []
    row_lines = []
    skip = []
    cols = None
    used = set()
    sec = None
    sec_col = 0
    n = len(lines)
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if i in used:
            continue
        s = line.strip()
        if not s:
            sec = None
            continue
        m = TITLE.match(line)
        if m:
            info['System'] = m.group('sys')
            info_lines.append(i)
            continue
        m = DATE.match(line)
        if m:
            info['Date'] = m.group('date')
            info['Time'] = m.group('time')
            if m.group('tz'):
                info['Time zone'] = m.group('tz')
            info_lines.append(i)
            continue
        if HEAD.match(line) and i + 1 < n and lines[i + 1].strip():
            cols = merge(spans(line), spans(lines[i + 1]))
            row_lines.extend([i, i + 1])
            used.add(i + 1)
            sec = None
            continue
        if ROW.match(line):
            parts = s.split()
            c = cols if cols is not None else DEFAULT_COLS
            if len(parts) == len(c):
                rows.append(dict(zip(c, parts)))
                row_lines.append(i)
                continue
        if ':' in line and not s.startswith('===>'):
            got = False
            for km in KV.finditer(line):
                v = km.group(2)
                if not v:
                    continue
                g = km.group(1)
                k = g.strip()
                ks = km.start(1) + (len(g) - len(g.lstrip()))
                if sec and ks >= sec_col:
                    k = sec + ' ' + k
                info[k] = v.strip()
                got = True
            sm = SEC.search(line)
            if sm:
                sec = sm.group('name').strip()
                sec_col = sm.start('name')
                got = True
            if got:
                info_lines.append(i)
                continue
        sec = None
        skip.append(i)
    blocks = []
    if info:
        blocks.append({'name': 'system status', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': info_lines, 'records': [info]})
    if rows:
        blocks.append({'name': 'pools', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': row_lines, 'records': rows})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}

fixes: Line 2 'Auxiliary storage:' is a section header for the right-hand key/value column on lines 3-7. Those keys are System ASP, % system ASP used, Total, Current unprotect used and Maximum unprotect. The template drops that parent, so 'Total = 2048 G' cannot be told apart from any other total. Keep the section in the kv output. One way is to prefix those keys with it (e.g. 'Auxiliary storage Total'). The other is to emit a 'section' column, filled for every right-half pair on lines 3-7 from the header on line 2. Find the split by text position: right-half pairs start at the column where 'Auxiliary storage:' begins. This needs the format-2 parser to remember the header and its column offset.

The pools table's column names are hard-coded in COLS, and ROW requires exactly 11 fields. On later captures of WRKSYSSTS showing another view (F11 switches to layouts with different columns, e.g. Paging Option), rows will either be mislabelled or silently fail to match. Build the column names from the two header lines (11-12) above the rows. Merge each upper header word (including the -----DB----- / ---Non-DB--- group labels) with the lower word below it, by character position. Accept rows whose field count matches the parsed header.
